gen-gf-autour-one-gf-tiny5: Chunky pixel-sized charm, then a heading like bent tubing. Autour One is the one that grabs attention with its round, uniform-gauge letters, while Tiny5 is the one that keeps quiet, its sans-serif text tall and its ascenders stubby.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-ubuntu: Autour One draws every round letter with a clear channel leading in and no tapering at all, like a pen that never leans. Ubuntu follows with a lofty, tidy lowercase that reads smoothly.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-victor-mono: Loud, round and unshaded: that's Autour One. Victor Mono, a monospace with loose spacing and bowls left open on one side, brings a typewriter-like order, while the heading saves its punch for big, short lines.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-viga: Viga keeps its capitals low, hairline-free and shadowless. Pair it with Autour One and the strongest quality is how smoothly a bold, expressive heading hands off to text that stays quietly sans.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-voces: Voces is a sans-serif with tall lowercase and only mild thick-thin variation in its strokes. Autour One never swells or tapers, so Voces gives a longer read a gentle, steady rhythm beneath it.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-winky-rough: Winky Rough holds its lowercase nearly up to the capitals, giving the sans-serif body a compact, level look. And if Autour One were shrunk down, its bold round shapes would lose the punch they get from size.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-winky-sans: Autour One has no pinched joins and no swelling bowls, just round letters entered through a clear channel. And Winky Sans, a plain sans with capitals barely above its lowercase, does the quiet work of carrying the text.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-yantramanav: Yantramanav reads tight and modern, its tall lowercase nearly meeting the capitals with open gaps in the rounds. Autour One, drawn like outlines in a single width, leads into a plain sans that moves along briskly.
gen-gf-autour-one-outfit: Outfit is a sans-serif with curves that stop short of closing and no swelling or thinning, like bent cable. And Autour One earns its keep big and short, where its bold round letters have room to speak.
gen-gf-autour-one-plus-jakarta-sans: Autour One has round letters with no hairline-to-stem shift at all. Plus Jakarta Sans, a plain sans of monoline strokes and well-separated curve endings, sits lower and lighter underneath, letting that bold heading lead while the text follows.
